name: Seek
overview: The Scriptures emphasize the vital importance of earnestly seeking God with all one’s heart and soul, promising that such pursuit results in finding Him (Deuteronomy 4:29; Jeremiah 29:13). Believers are called to seek God’s presence and righteousness above all else, as exemplified in the command to seek first the kingdom of God (Matthew 6:33) and to seek the Lord while He may be found (Isaiah 55:6). This seeking is characterized by a wholehearted devotion and a desire for truth, reflecting a personal relationship where God responds to those who diligently seek Him early and sincerely (Proverbs 8:17; Psalms 27:8).
